parent_objective: design extreme hidden-condition scenario corpus after source-mining branch pivot

public_gates: design covers current-model hidden capability faults
design distinguishes current single-track proxies from future true four-wheel faults
design keeps hidden fault labels out of actor input
design specifies matched hidden-condition ambiguity requirements
design blocks actor update PPO and promotion
design defines no-training corpus artifacts and acceptance criteria
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add fault labels to actor observations
do not call single-track proxies true single-wheel failures
do not generate only hard scenarios without matched hidden-condition ambiguity
do not reintroduce reference-path or TTC oracle inputs

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_extreme_source: create hidden-condition scenario distributions that make online command-response self-identification necessary
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs the first no-training extreme hidden-condition scenario corpus after M702 pivot
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: scenario-corpus design only, not implementation, training, PPO, or driver performance
stop_condition: stop if the design cannot separate hidden generation labels from actor inputs
stop if all proposed faults require four-wheel physics before any current-model proxy can be tested
stop if matched hidden-condition ambiguity is not part of the acceptance criteria
fallback_plan: if current single-track proxies are insufficient, design a minimal four-wheel dynamics extension branch
if faults are too severe and all rows are normal-failed, add staged warm-up and severity ladders
if faults are too mild and history-insensitive, increase hidden-condition contrast before objective design
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: after an implementation and audit determine whether extreme hidden-condition rows are source-positive

hypothesis: A designed extreme hidden-condition scenario corpus can create matched current-state cases where online command-response history is necessary for evasive driving decisions.
success_criteria: design defines future four-wheel-only fault families separately
design defines severity ladders and warm-up timing
design defines matched hidden-condition pair criteria
design defines source-positive and negative-result classifications
objective actor update PPO and promotion remain blocked
failure_criteria: design adds hidden fault labels to actor input
design treats true single-wheel failures as available in the current single-track model
design admits actor update or PPO before source-positive evidence
decision_rule: M703 is design-only and passes if it specifies a no-training extreme hidden-condition scenario corpus while preserving the P0 actor input contract and blocking actor update PPO and promotion.
